rows.author: J089
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING AND MODERNIZING THE BUREAU OF FIRE PROTECTION  AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: \" Bureau Of Fire Protection Modernization Act \"
rows.abstract:
Aims to ensure public safety through the prevention and suppression of all kinds of destructive fires by modernizing the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

Provides additional functions of the BFP aside from its existing functions under Republic Act No. 9514, otherwise known as the “Fire Code of the Philippines of 2008”, and Republic Act No. 6975, otherwise known as the “Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1990.”

Establishes and implements the following components: a. Fire Protection Service; b. Force Restructuring and Organizational Development; c. Capability, Material, and Technology Development; d. Specialized Services Development; and e. Human Resource Development.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11589 enacted on 2021-09-10

rows.author: J089
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING THE PARTICIPATION OF CIVIL SOCIETY ORGANIZATIONS IN THE ANNUAL NATIONAL BUDGET PROCESS AND PROVIDING EFFECTIVE MECHANISMS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Institutionalizing The Participation Of Civil Society Organizations In The Annual National Budget Process
rows.abstract:
Aims to facilitate the establishment of adequate consultation and feedback mechanisms to promote meaningful and effective participation of civil society organizations (CSOs) in the preparation and authorization of the annual national budget.

Mandates the Offices of the Secretary of the Senate, the Secretary General of the House of Representatives, the Supreme Court Clerk of Court, and the Office of the Chairman of the Constitutional Offices to process the application for accreditation of civil society organizations.

Requires all NGAs and GOCCs to formulate and adopt guidelines outlining the mechanism for accreditation and active participation of the CSOs in the preparation of the annual national budget.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING CONSUMERS AND MERCHANTS ENGAGED IN INTERNET TRANSACTIONS, CREATING FOR THE PURPOSE THE ECOMMERCE BUREAU AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Intends to create an office to oversee the full implementation of R.A.No. 8792 or the Electronic Commerce Act of 2000 to address the safety and facility of using online platforms and build the ease and confidence of both customers and merchants.
Proposes several provisions regarding eCommerce transactions: a) Code of Conduct; b) Qualifications to Engage; c) Business Registration; d) Regulatory Jurisdiction of the DTI; e) Obligations of Online eCommerce Platforms; f) Responsibilities of an Online Merchant; g) Right to Redress by Online Merchants; h) Right to Terminate the Contract by the Consumer; i) Damages due to the Consumer; j) Online Dispute Resolution; k) Joint and Solidarity Liability; l) Digital Payments; m) Tax Exemption for Newly Registered eCommerce Enterprises; n) eCommerce Philippine Trustmark, and o) Data Retention and Protection.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2020-08-26
